'''2026 Retro Worlds Alex Prodoehl DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alex Prodoehl]] at the [[2026 Retro World Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Alex Prodoehl]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Retro World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Objective:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations-decipher-archive.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26RWC Prodoehl DS ROps.txt |Download]]
